child: heard patient shout after twisting knee

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Tell me exactly what happened to your knee.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I injured my right knee playing football two days ago. I turned suddenly while my foot was still planted on the ground.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: I was watching. He twisted his leg and shouted straight away.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: The knee started swelling during the evening and was much larger the next morning.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Can you put your full weight on the leg?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I can stand on it, but walking is difficult and bending the knee hurts.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Did you hear or feel a pop when the injury happened?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I felt something move inside the knee, but I cannot remember hearing a clear pop.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: We put ice on it and he has tried to keep the leg raised.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: He has also been walking very slowly since the match.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: I will examine the ligaments and movement of the knee and decide whether imaging is needed.
